Preview, Proposal, Approval and ExecutionLease did not prove that action type, capability, account, adapter, risk and budget described one exact dependency set
legacy proposals without a Preview could still reach approval and lease paths
ProductionStartDecision and external Action ExecutionLease needed an explicit non-substitution boundary
ExternalActionPreviewProfileRevision makes external-action refs mandatory without weakening internal no-provider production compatibility
server-owned actionBindingHash now binds Preview, Proposal, Approval, ExecutionLease, Receipt and Lineage to the same exact dependency set
domain calculators, adapter dryValidate and policy authorities own impact facts; client-submitted values cannot become authority
ProductionStartDecision creates only a TaskRun and never grants an external Action ExecutionLease
W5-02 remains unchecked until W5-00 and W5-01 dependencies, account authority, mandatory Preview enforcement and transitive revocation are GREEN
